name: io.github.sweetcornna/free-search-mcp
title: Free Search
description: No-API-key web search, page fetching and document reading across many engines. Local-first.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional outbound proxy URL (http://, https:// or socks5://) for engines that block your network.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_MCP_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Optional default region-language for results, e.g. us-en, uk-en, cn-zh. Default: us-en.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory for the local search/page cache. Default: ~/.cache/search-mcp.
